title: Cisco security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-362.09.25.20: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – Cisco Security Updates
leadParagraph: Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products.
contentHtml:
Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products.

A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

Administrators are encouraged to review and apply the necessary updates.For further information and support, please visit the Cisco security page .
